d:
Panjab ke mohali men rahne vale trak draivar baljindar sinh ne divali banpar lotri men 12 karor rupye jite hain. vah pichhle 15 sal se lotri tikat kharid rahe the, lekin unhonne iski jankari apne parivar ko bhi nahin di thi. karoron rupye jitne ke bavjud baljindar sinh draiving ka kam jari rakhna chahte hain. unka kahna hai ki is jit se unki zindgi jine ka tarika nahin badlega.
Riport: navjot kaur
Kaimra: mayank mongiya
Edit: rajan papneja
Chetavnih lotri ya jue ki lat lag sakti hai, isse savdhan rahen.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
